title.en: Learn music from people who play it

id: Kami mengajarkan keahlian di balik suara: teori, vokal, engineering, dan ritme, lewat kursus singkat, praktis, dan bertahap.
Setiap kursus dibuat oleh musisi dan produser profesional, jadi kamu belajar hal yang benar-benar penting di studio maupun di atas panggung.
en: We teach the craft behind the sound: theory, voice, engineering and rhythm, through short, practical, step-by-step courses.
Every course is built by working musicians and producers, so you learn what actually matters in a studio or on a stage.

desc.id: Pengantar teori musik: kenali paranada, kunci, nilai ritme dan nada, birama, serta tanda waktu.
desc.en: An introduction to music theory, will introduce you to music staves, clefs, rhythmic and pitch values, rhythmic metre and time signatures.

desc.id: Pelajari latihan vokal dan teknik bernyanyi untuk memahami musik dan menjadi penyanyi yang lebih baik, apa pun gaya musik favoritmu.
desc.en: Learn various vocal exercises and singing techniques to understand music and become a better singer, regardless of what musical styles you prefer.

desc.id: Kursus bertahap tentang mastering engineering. Pelajari cara meningkatkan kualitas audio musikmu.
desc.en: The step-by-step course about mastering engineering. Learn how to improve the audio quality of your music.

desc.id: Buat beat yang lebih baik lewat pola drum programming dan tips gaya, termasuk Hip Hop, Footwork, Funk, dan masih banyak lagi.
desc.en: Build Better Beats through drum programming patterns and style tips including Hip Hop, Footwork, Funk, and much more
